import_configuration.format: GLB with embedded PBR texture maps
import_configuration.up_axis: glTF Y up converted from Blender Z up

instructions: Transfer the approved Scavenger depot target. Fit the 24 x 13 x 20 inch envelope. Build a wide clear loading bay framed by fixed blue and cream appliance side slabs, a centered block-and-tackle on a braced timber crossbeam, a shallow asymmetric roof of large overlapping mismatched sheets, repaired drawer-board walls, a side crate and a wire basket. Preserve an uninterrupted center route from the front sill to the rear wall. Use broad material blocks and believable attachment details; keep every roof and hoist load visibly connected to framing.
material_method: Component-modeled reclaimed timber, fixed appliance enamel panels and perforated wire storage with baked broad-scale PBR patina for enamel and galvanized sheets; no Clockwork copper, brass, gear or boiler treatment.
post_processing: Validate the GLB in Godot against the exact 24 x 13 x 20 inch envelope and verify PBR bindings.
Render close, 64-inch settlement, and 330-inch room views through the review-only Scavenger presentation registry.
Have Luna inspect actual Godot pixels against the approved concept and the current gameplay capture; retain the production registry until the candidate passes its gates.
tool: Blender component authoring with embedded PBR maps through the RoomScale Art Factory
